v6.26.3.edition: Outlook delayed execution + authoritative Outlook SL + 1000-pip ceiling
v6.26.3.compiler_result: 0 errors, 0 warnings (MetaEditor64.exe via Wine, Mac live install)
v6.26.3.release_notes: Market Outlook signals that fire real trades now wait the same 2-3 minute entry delay as normal trades (one delay only), re-validate on execution, and use the signal's own stop-loss - recalculating position size from the actual entry price to that stop. If the stop is no longer valid at execution, the trade is skipped rather than opened with a substitute stop. Keeps the 1000-pip profit ceiling. Connects to xaucloud.io. No change to normal-entry evidence logic, risk %, profit floor, 70% peak protection, 45% giveback, runner, 10-minute extension, or exit rules.
